supra.upside: A real layer-1 with oracle and automation products and big-name backers; a fresh product launch or exchange push could re-rate a $7M chain, but I found nothing dated after mid-2026.
supra.cheap: It is down about 99.8% from its 2024 high after the team raised the max supply to 100B, so the market sees endless dilution, not a bargain.
supra.wrongIf: No dated product or listing news by end of December and the 39% weekly gain fades back.

ika.upside: Active code and Sui backing; a big wallet or protocol integration could matter, but nothing is dated.
ika.cheap: Only 30% of tokens are out and holders keep selling; it is not ignored, it is being sold.
ika.wrongIf: Price keeps making new lows through November or daily trading falls under $300K.
ika.vsScanner: Disagree that the trading spike is a positive; it came with a 28% one-day drop, which looks like selling, not buying.

vvs-finance.vsScanner: Agree it is real, but the scanner's own flags (thin trading, unlocks) outweigh its score.
